description: Gmail inbox leads eval (PRD 7.27, ADR-0020). Each email is read against Olvessa's sample catalogue in memory, with the deals listed here, so nothing is written. 'verdict' is the verdict code must reach, or a list of acceptable ones; 'notVerdict' lists verdicts it must never reach. 'matchesAny' passes if any kept match is in one of those offerings. All companies and people are fictional.

emails.subject: Moving our servers to Google Cloud: proposal and a call?
emails.body:
Hi Olvessa team,

We're a logistics company in Klang. We run about 140 virtual machines in our own data centre, and the lease on it ends in June 2027.

We'd like to move to Google Cloud and need help with the landing zone and the migration itself. After that we'd want someone to look after it day to day.

Could you send us a proposal, and could we have a call next week? The budget for this is approved for this financial year.

Regards,
Hafiz Rahman
Head of IT, Pelita Waris Logistics

emails.subject: Help moving our ERP and file servers to Google Cloud
emails.body:
Hi Olvessa team,

We're a 300-person furniture manufacturer in Shah Alam. Our ERP and file servers run on 45 virtual machines in a server room that we need to empty by March 2027, when the building lease ends.

We want to move everything to Google Cloud, with a proper landing zone, and then have someone manage it for us afterwards. Could you send us a proposal and suggest a time for a call next week? Budget for this has been approved by our board.

Thanks,
Liyana Hashim
IT Manager, Rimbun Kayu Industries

emails.subject: Workspace for a 25-person firm?
emails.body:
Hello,

We're a 25-person accounting firm on another email provider and thinking of switching to Google Workspace. Do you help with moving mailboxes and training the staff? Roughly what does it involve?

Thanks,
Aisyah
